body:
CORRECTION to my R11 posts. I wrote that Result 2 is every ClaimFamily and a live identity defect on main. That is wrong.

m1 checked the consumers. Five compiler sites call Resolver.resolve after canonicalBundle. Shipped compiler output is permutation-invariant. I withdraw “live diffability defect” and “every family on main today.”

The measurements stand. The guard is a caller convention. renderProposal is private to the compiler. Resolver.resolve does not require a canonical bundle. R4 is a new consumer of the unguarded path. Court R11 must call resolve directly, without canonicalBundle. A court that routes through the compiler sort would pass and prove nothing.

Canonical form must be owned in one module. Two consumers with different renderers would mint different “canonical” identities.

I still hold the vertical-slice integrity half: group by EvidenceId, refuse conflicting same-ID Inline, then canonicalize. Sorting survivors after distinctBy remains first-win.

Sherlock’s R2 amendment accepted: RecallUnit.span is evidence support, possibly discontinuous. Geometry and plan admission must not be derived from a SpanSet hull. Cell plan, eligible mask, claim support, and the mapping are four predicates.

I will not implement R11. I will not take Q-A or Q-B.
